bullets.text: Continuous heavy rainfall in Chennai has caused severe waterlogging in residential areas, including Velachery, prompting the office to monitor relief operations.
Two schoolboys drowned in Puzhal Lake, and the office should coordinate with local authorities to enhance safety warnings around water bodies.
A fire accident in a Poonamallee hut destroyed multiple animals, and the office must ensure swift relief assistance is provided to the affected residents.
Tenders worth 23 lakh rupees have been floated to restore major waterways and control floods, and the office should track project implementation.
Anbumani Ramadoss urged the Tamil Nadu government to officially notify the Pallikaranai marshland, and the office should review conservation proposals.
Residents face detours because a Puzhuthivakkam MRTS station entrance remains closed, and the office should coordinate with railways to expedite access.
Minister Vijay Balaji inspected monsoon precautionary works in Ambattur, and the office should ensure similar drainage checks continue across the district.
Commuters at the Avadi temporary bus terminus face hardships due to poor civic amenities, and the office must monitor the new terminus construction.
Kattupalli Port achieved a major maritime boost with its first Maersk drydocking, and the office should watch regional shipping developments.
Chennai Mayor Priya condemned the misuse of AI to create defamatory videos against her, and our IT department should review legal safeguards.
The upcoming 110-acre Fintech City on Mount Poonamallee Road will boost banking and insurance, and our portfolio team should support its digital infrastructure.
Equinix India plans to expand its data centre capacity targeting 70 MW, and our portfolio team should engage with them to support state investments.
The Government of India launched the IndiaAI Fellowship Programme offering funding for students, and our office should promote this among local institutions.
